def replace_dots(s):
    while True:
        p = s.find("dot", 1)
        if p == -1 or p > len(s) - 4:
            break
        s = s[:p] + "." + s[p+3:]
    return s

def main():
    s = input().strip()
    at_pos = s.find("at", 1)
    if at_pos != -1:
        s = s[:at_pos] + "@" + s[at_pos+2:]
    s = replace_dots(s)
    print(s)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
